3_description:
New from-scratch family `models_r2/r2s1_stagefree_permode` (worktree `worktrees/r2s1_direct/B3`), condition-only forward signature, stripped view only, leakage tripwire, no LF at any stage. Per dataset: disjoint fit 80% / model-selection 10% / calibration 10% folds, asserted disjoint (LOO + fixed-epoch when `N_train < 20`, i.e. ifc_poisson); no test quantity is consulted in any fit or selection step.
  **The load-bearing move**: the scored column is **stage-free**. `test_hf` = closed-form head with **no Wiener gains and no blend**; the shared post-hoc stage is demoted to `stage_*` reference splits and becomes the measured object.
  **Head (C1 + C3 repairs)**: centering form by `ratio = ||mean_i y_i|| / geomean_i ||y_i||`, tau = 1.0 (`fact` / `add`); direction bank = {DC / spatial-mean direction} u {POD modes 0-49 of the **DC-removed** fit-fold residual, computed in the **selected centering form** — fixes B2's hardcoded-add-basis defect T1-F7}; per direction a 5-fold OOF R^2 from the condition under the map bank {affine, quadratic, RBF kernel ridge, k-NN}, best family selected out of fold; fitted **SET** = directions clearing tau = 0.1 (min 1, max 32) — **SET indexing replaces B2's window indexing** (worth 5.62x mce on cahn_hilliard). Including the DC direction as an explicit OOF candidate makes `dc_only` a *selected special case* of the head rather than a competitor picked on test.
  **Reference splits** (never prefixed `test`): `ref_head_set_affine` (affine-only — isolates the map bank), `ref_head_window_affine` (B2's rule — isolates the arity repair), `ref_decoder_big` (FiLM-FNO w64/b4/modes16/latent16, 200 epochs, early-stopped on the model fold, RAW), `stage_wiener_{head,decoder}`, `stage_blend_{head,decoder}` (decorrelation-audited base set), `stage_bg_{head,decoder}` (**Bates-Granger 1969** minimum-variance weights `w=(1'S^-1 1)^-1 1 S^-1` from the calibration-fold prediction-error covariance, Ledoit-Wolf shrunk), floors `ref_dc_only`, `ref_zero`, `ref_train_mean`, `ref_nn_condition` (the last three seam-checked to `state/anchors/floors.json` at 1e-9, RAISING on mismatch). Guards `heat_local, fluid, sharp__sod_1d` at contract tier.
  **Build gates**: (G-A) every decoder arm ships `preds_test.npz` per dataset — HARD gate, B2 part 7 item 4; (G-B) the rho-prelude JSON (calibration-fold sigma_arm, sigma_base, rho, lambda*, and the Bates-Granger predicted post-stage test error per arm x base) is written **before any test tensor is read**; (G-C) floor seam check raises; (G-D) Wiener grid **capped at [0, 1.5]** (NOT widened — B2 part 7 item 3) with an explicit stand-down (identity) candidate and the least-squares-optimal per-band gain reported alongside; (G-E) any blend base with calibration-fold `|rho| > 0.95` to an arm's error is DROPPED for that arm and the drop recorded.
  **Diagnostics (JSON, non-scored)**: per-direction OOF R^2 x map-family table with the selected family and the per-mode ORACLE ceiling explicitly labelled ORACLE; SET-vs-window index sets per dataset; the rho matrix with predicted-vs-realized stage payoff; Wiener gains vs LS-optimal gains; the H2 projection of the decoder's own test predictions onto the fit-fold basis, split into fitted-SET / in-window-complement / basis-orthogonal energy (cahn_hilliard, allen_cahn) — **diagnostic only, C4 is not prior-art-checked and must not be headlined**.

PRELUDE VALIDATION at contract tier (the L2 instrument working end to end on helmholtz): for the head arm the prelude predicted the post-blend error as 0.7998 from calibration-fold moments alone (rho = +0.0336 vs the zero base, sigma_arm 1.2707, sigma_base 1.0000, lambda*_BG 0.378, blend-selected lambda 0.35); the realized test stage_blend_head came out at 0.761942. For the decoder arm it predicted 1.0000 at the selected lambda = 0.00 and the realized stage_blend_decoder was exactly 1.000000 - i.e. that arm was REPORTING THE BASE, the B2 T3-F6 reading. Two sigma conventions (mean_of_norms = the round metric itself; rms = the law's native second-moment units) are emitted so the analyzer never has to guess.

STAGE SEMANTICS (builder decision, card-consistent): each stage is applied INDEPENDENTLY to its raw arm (stage_wiener_* = arm + gains; stage_blend_* = arm + blend; stage_bg_* = arm + Bates-Granger combination), not composed as B2's wiener-then-blend chain. Reason: the card's R2S1B3_REF_ARMS lists the three stage families separately and the L2 clause compares the prelude's rho row against the realized stage arm, so a one-to-one correspondence between the predicted and the realized object is required. No extra split beyond the card's arm list was added.

REGISTRATION (program.md §12 / ADR r2-0004): registration.py transcribes panel_data.py's three coordinate maps (variant C node-aligned periodic with wrap; variant E interior-node Dirichlet; legacy cell-centred) as separable, differentiable torch gathers, and dispatches per dataset name. The family contains NO bare F.interpolate and NO scipy zoom on any field (grep-verified); the single F.interpolate reference is a conformance assertion in registration.self_test(). Measured in-run: nested-node invariant max|err| = 0.0 (up[::2,::2] == coarse exactly), legacy branch vs align_corners=False max|err| = 3.33e-16. The decoder's working-grid -> native-grid resample never fires on the round-2 panel or guard set (every native grid <= the 256 work cap; `decoder_regrid_fired` = false on both smoked datasets), but the dispatch is in place so an unseen dataset cannot silently reintroduce the (r-1)/2 defect.

TARGET-SCALER PRE-FLIGHT (program.md §12, mandatory for helmholtz/pfc cards) RUN AND RECORDED: `python tools/target_scale_spread_audit.py --datasets ext__helmholtz_2d,sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d --out <wt>/scratchpad/scaler_preflight.json` -> ext__helmholtz_2d verdict BOTH (top-1 energy share 0.892, effective N 1.2/400, median normalised target 1.56e-4); sharp__phase_field_crystal_2d verdict NEAR_ZERO_TARGETS (median normalised target 1.26e-5). JUSTIFICATION for proceeding: those verdicts describe a GLOBALLY-normalised (HF - LF_up) residual target, and this family has no residual target and no global scaler anywhere. Both remedies the rule asks for are already structural - (a) the decoder trains under a per-sample relative-L2 loss with a p25 denominator floor, and (b) the closed-form head's `fact` centering form IS a per-sample amplitude factorization, which the card's centering rule selects on helmholtz (measured ratio 3.2476 >= tau 1.0; in-run selected form on the smoke was `fact`). A direct HF-target spread measurement is recorded at <wt>/scratchpad/hf_target_spread.json: helmholtz HF norms are outlier-dominated (top-1 energy share 0.993, eff N 1/400) which is exactly why `fact` is selected there, while pfc HF norms are tight (max/median 1.39, eff N frac 0.86) and its centering ratio 0.8325 < 1.0 selects `add`, for which no per-sample normalisation is needed.

HYPERPARAMETER PROVENANCE - every value is recipe, prior-best-cited, or a declared reading; none is a guess. FROM THE RECIPE (verbatim, machine-checked): all 72 non-underscore recipe.env keys appear byte-identically in models_r2/r2s1_stagefree_permode/config.py::RECIPE_ENV AND in scripts/01_train_eval.sh's ENV_ARGS (verified programmatically: 72/72 keys present in both, zero value mismatches, zero extras). The 9 keys prefixed `_` are card directives and are deliberately absent from --env (starter handoff). NOT FIXED BY THE CARD, each a prior-best: (1) WIENER_BAND_EDGES = (4, 8, 16, 32) - the card fixes only the band COUNT (6); these are tools/band_gain_counterfactual.py's default edges and B2's shipped bands, kept identical so B3's Wiener stage is comparable to B2's. (2) DEC_COND_RFF = 16 - B1's R2S1_COND_RFF, carried by B2, so ref_decoder_big is the same decoder at the same scale across B1/B2/B3. (3) BG_LW_OBSERVATION = one calibration SAMPLE per Ledoit-Wolf observation - the card fixes the shrinkage family and the covariance source, not the observation unit; the sample is the natural unit because the round metric averages over samples. (4) POD by the method of snapshots (Gram eigendecomposition, Sirovich 1987) with sub-sqrt(eps) modes dropped - a numerical route, B2's measured ~40x speedup. (5) decoder GELU / 1x1 local path / zero-init FiLM / N(0,1) RFF frequencies - all four are B1's decoder, carried by B2. (6) p25 as the lower edge of the card's `p25_median` denominator-floor BAND - what B1 and B2 shipped.

TWO BUILDER DECISIONS worth reviewer attention. (a) PER-EPOCH CHECKPOINTS: R2S1B3_DEC_CKPT_EVERY_EPOCH=1 is honoured verbatim for every checkpointed (main) decoder run - `<ckpt_dir>/last.pt` is rewritten after every epoch with model+optimizer+scheduler+best_state+history+torch RNG state (R2S1B3_DEC_CKPT_RNG_STATE=1), ~224 MB per save. It is DISABLED inside the small-N leave-one-out refits, where the resumable unit is the LOO fold (whose artifact, the fold's per-sample prediction, is already checkpointed by ckpt.finish) and an in-fold per-epoch save would add ~200 GB of writes over the ifc_poisson leg for no resume benefit. (b) The R2S1B3_FOLD_RESAMPLES=5 paired-spread diagnostic measures the STAGE arms (stage_blend_head vs stage_blend_decoder) rather than test_hf, because a stage-free scored column is invariant to the calibration partition by construction; that invariance is asserted and recorded rather than measured.

N_PARAMS READING (for the analyzer, not a defect): the head's parameter count is reported honestly per map family - affine (d+1)/direction, quadratic 1+d+d(d+1)/2, RBF kernel ridge ONE DUAL COEFFICIENT PER FITTING ROW, k-NN one integer. On a dataset where the OOF selection picks kernel ridge for most SET directions the count is therefore ~10^3-10^4, not 10^2 (helmholtz smoke: SET of 32 directions, 28 kernel-ridge -> scored_head n_params 8964 vs ref_head_set_affine 128). On ifc_poisson the SET was 3 affine directions -> 18 parameters. Read the per-arm n_params block, not the card's headline '<= 10^2-parameter' phrasing, when pricing the capacity comparison.

WATCH ITEM (not a bug): on ext__helmholtz_2d the Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage intensity came out at delta = 0.683, which pulls the minimum-variance weights toward uniform (0.256/0.258/0.201/0.154/0.132 over {arm, zero, train_mean, nn_condition, dc_only}) and makes stage_bg_* worse than its own arm there. That is the canonical Ledoit-Wolf estimator behaving correctly under helmholtz's extremely heterogeneous per-sample error energies (the same OUTLIER_DOMINATED property the scaler pre-flight flagged), not an implementation fault; expect a much smaller delta on the sharp datasets, whose per-sample norms are tight. helmholtz is report-only in any case.

debug_notes.symptom: job 66262741 (seed 0) FAILED exit 1:0 after 13:21. The PANEL leg completed green (all 6 datasets, panel_geomean_skill 18.7500, helmholtz nRMSE 1.140818); the GUARD leg then died on heat_local with ScoreContractError wrapping `RuntimeError: direction bank is not orthonormal: max|DD'-I| = 8.351e-01` (basis.py:150, raised from head.selection_stage -> DirectionBank.__init__).
debug_notes.diagnosis: Numerical-rank screen in `basis.pod_basis`, not the bank assert. POD is computed by the method of snapshots (eigendecomposition of the n x n Gram), which SQUARES the condition number, but modes were screened with `s_i > sqrt(eps)*s_max` — exactly the point at which the Gram eigenvalue ratio reaches machine eps, i.e. ZERO margin, so the marginal eigenvector can be pure roundoff. heat_local's DC-removed fit-fold residual decays through that boundary: 33 modes cleared the screen, the last at s/s_max = 1.81e-8, and it came back with ||v|| = 0.366, giving 1 - 0.366^2 = 0.866 = the reported error. Panel datasets never approach the boundary (smallest retained relative singular value: helmholtz 2.0e-3, fluid 1.3e-2, sod_1d 1.3e-4), which is why the bug hid until the guard leg. Reproduced in scratchpad/diagnose_attempt_1.py (worst offdiag at [33,33]; row norm 0.366).
debug_notes.fix: `pod_basis` is made SELF-VALIDATING rather than given a tuned threshold: since modes are ordered by decreasing s and the leading r x r block of Vt Vt' IS the Gram of the first r modes, the new `_orthonormal_rank` helper truncates to the largest leading rank whose block satisfies max|VV'-I| <= 1e-9 (POD_ORTHO_TOL). A magic safety factor on the singular-value screen was measured and rejected: a 1e2 margin still leaves heat_local at 3.2e-7, above the bank's own 1e-8 assert. Blast radius measured over all 9 panel+guard datasets (scratchpad/diagnose_attempt_1b.json, verify_attempt_1.json): every SCORED panel dataset keeps an IDENTICAL retained-mode count (50/50/50/50/50/4), as do fluid and sod_1d, so no scored quantity can move; only heat_local changes, 33 -> 17 POD modes, with bank orthonormality error 8.66e-1 -> 2.84e-10. Downstream code already tolerates a narrower bank (smoke_eval.py:132 filters set_indices by bank.m; head.py:90 clips the window by window.m). E2E repro of the exact failing path — score_panel.py --datasets heat_local --epochs 2 --seed 0 --no_cache — now exits 0 with heat_local nRMSE 1.6531e-4 (scratchpad/repro_1_heat_local_postfix.json). The panel leg must nonetheless re-run because the family code_hash changed (1e9abd22... -> e7078dee...).
debug_notes.next_suggestion: If the guard leg fails again on heat_local, suspect an arm that assumes a full-width bank (blend/Bates-Granger covariance, or the band-wise Wiener stage over 18 rather than 51 directions) rather than the basis construction. For the analyst: heat_local's SET is now rank-limited (bank has 18 directions) and can never reach the SELECT_MAX=32 clip — read its clip_rule accordingly; it is a guard dataset, so no falsification clause depends on it.
